rainfall.label: Rainfall
rainfall.summary: 1 of 3 region-variable series show a trend that stays significant after Benjamini-Hochberg false-discovery-rate correction at 0.05.

rows.headline: rainfall in Central Sahel, Africa: increasing by 1.0 mm/month per decade (+2.7% per decade), significant after multiple-testing correction (q < 0.001).
rainfall in Indo-Gangetic Plain (analysis box): no trend that survives multiple-testing correction (q = 0.918; estimate -0.4 mm/month per decade).
rainfall in Tamil Nadu region (analysis box): no trend that survives multiple-testing correction (q = 0.918; estimate 0.4 mm/month per decade).

aod.label: Aerosol optical depth (AOD)
aod.summary: 2 of 2 region-variable series show a trend that stays significant after Benjamini-Hochberg false-discovery-rate correction at 0.05.

rows.headline: AOD in Tamil Nadu region (analysis box): increasing by 0.049 per decade (+15.9% per decade), significant after multiple-testing correction (q < 0.001).
AOD in Indo-Gangetic Plain (analysis box): increasing by 0.083 per decade (+15.7% per decade), significant after multiple-testing correction (q < 0.001).

air_temperature.label: Near-surface air temperature
air_temperature.summary: 1 of 5 region-variable series show a trend that stays significant after Benjamini-Hochberg false-discovery-rate correction at 0.05.

rows.headline: near-surface air temperature in Southern Amazon 'arc of deforestation', Brazil: increasing by 0.641 degC per decade, significant after multiple-testing correction (q < 0.001).
near-surface air temperature in Tamil Nadu region (analysis box): no trend that survives multiple-testing correction (q = 0.072; estimate 0.22 degC per decade).
near-surface air temperature in Los Angeles basin, USA: no trend that survives multiple-testing correction (q = 0.102; estimate 0.347 degC per decade).
near-surface air temperature in Delhi National Capital Region: no trend that survives multiple-testing correction (q = 0.397; estimate -0.196 degC per decade).
near-surface air temperature in Indo-Gangetic Plain (analysis box): no trend that survives multiple-testing correction (q = 0.998; estimate -0.000325 degC per decade).

no2.label: Nitrogen dioxide (tropospheric column)
no2.summary: 1 of 2 region-variable series show a trend that stays significant after Benjamini-Hochberg false-discovery-rate correction at 0.05.

rows.headline: NO2 (tropospheric column) in Los Angeles basin, USA: decreasing by 3.45e+15 molecules/cm2 per decade (-51.5% per decade), significant after multiple-testing correction (q < 0.001).
NO2 (tropospheric column) in Delhi National Capital Region: no trend that survives multiple-testing correction (q = 0.273; estimate -2.28e+14 molecules/cm2 per decade).
